# EasyInviteMaker

> Digital wedding invitations you can share on WhatsApp. Choose an
> animated design, add your names, dates and photos for free, then
> publish for a one-time ₹599 (no subscription) and share a single
> link your guests open on their phone, no app required.

For weddings, engagements, receptions, haldi and mehendi.

## Pages

- [Home](https://easyinvitemaker.com/): overview and the design gallery
- [Templates](https://easyinvitemaker.com/templates): all available invitation designs
- [Wedding invitation wording](https://easyinvitemaker.com/wedding-invitation-wording): wording examples
- [Engagement invitation wording](https://easyinvitemaker.com/engagement-invitation-wording)
- [Haldi invitation wording](https://easyinvitemaker.com/haldi-invitation-wording)
- [Mehendi invitation wording](https://easyinvitemaker.com/mehendi-invitation-wording)
- [Reception invitation wording](https://easyinvitemaker.com/reception-invitation-wording)
- [Sharing an invitation on WhatsApp](https://easyinvitemaker.com/share-invitation-on-whatsapp)
- [Contact](https://easyinvitemaker.com/contact)
